item.title: Probe Denial Of Overtime Allowance For Paramedics, Ambulance Drivers: Ex-Senator
item.description:

item.title: No Extension For Contract Pharmacists, Applications Open End 2027: MOH
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
MOH says there are no contract extensions for over 40 pharmacists who lost their jobs last Saturday because they reached their max 5-year contract duration. They may reapply in more than one and a half year's time when permanent recruitment opens end 2027.
